text: はっ　はあ　はあ…　いきとる　うちに　この　わざを　おしえられる　もんに　あえる　とは　おもわなんだ

structure.jp: はっ　はあ　はあ…
この　わざを　おしえられる　もんに
structure.en: someone I can teach this move to
that I'd be able to meet

patterns.name: 〜うちに
patterns.explanation: うちに after a verb means 'while that is still so'. いきとる is the old-man form of いきている. いきとる　うちに = 'while I'm still alive'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: この　わざを　おしえられる　もん
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a person or thing describes it. おしえられる is 'can teach', and もん is a short もの, 'person'. この　わざを　おしえられる　もん = 'someone I can teach this move to'.

patterns.name: 〜とは
patterns.span: あえる　とは　おもわなんだ
patterns.explanation: とは before 'think' shows the surprising thing you thought or didn't think. おもわなんだ is an old dialect form of おもわなかった. あえる　とは　おもわなんだ = 'I never thought I'd get to meet one'.
